what: Rows in the name list stand faded at .7. Only the hovered row brightens to 1 (.3s expoOut), and the paired mark (logo) in the next column slides to that row’s height in .2s and swaps. On leave, the row finishes brightening, then returns to .7 in .3s. On phones, the mark for the row caught in a thin band at the screen center lights up
use:
Logo 1Logo 2

  • Partner 2
note: The marks field sets the first list row height to 0 and shifts top — place it in the same reference box as the list, and the part hangs position as absolute. On phone, the marks field is sticky at the screen center
